args.justification: 允许将已验证 PPT 与修改记录提交推送到 GitHub 研发分支吗？

args.cmd:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,pathlib,subprocess,sys
paths=json.loads(pathlib.Path('/tmp/bigsmall-proposal-ppt-git-paths.json').read_text())
for label,args in [('stage',['git','add','--force','--',*paths]),('commit',['git','commit','--quiet','--only','-m','docs: restructure Ning proposal slides using reference outline','--',*paths])]:
 r=subprocess.run(args,text=True,capture_output=True)
 print(json.dumps({'step':label,'exit_code':r.returncode,'stdout':r.stdout,'stderr':r.stderr},ensure_ascii=False))
 if r.returncode:sys.exit(r.returncode)
sha=subprocess.run(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.strip()
changed=subprocess.run(['git','diff-tree','--no-commit-id','--name-only','-r','-z',sha],capture_output=True,check=True).stdout.decode().rstrip('\0').split('\0')
assert set(changed)==set(paths)
print(json.dumps({'commit':sha,'committed_paths':len(changed),'explicit_path_match':True},ensure_ascii=False))
PY
